name: PAMAP2 → UCI-HAR
description: Train on PAMAP2 (12 activities, 3 body-worn IMUs, 27 channels, 8 subjects) and evaluate on UCI-HAR (6 activities, waist smartphone, 9 channels, 30 subjects). Only the 6 shared activity classes are evaluated: Walking, Walking Upstairs, Walking Downstairs, Sitting, Standing, and Lying. This pair tests generalization from multiple sensors to a single sensor. The source domain is much larger than the target.

protocol.type: Train on source, test on target
protocol.source_train: PAMAP2 subjects 1–7 (LOSO folds, each used as source)
protocol.note: PAMAP2 has 3 IMU positions; pick one (chest recommended) or use all three. UCI-HAR test set is the standard 9 subjects (22–30).
